id: 17_Safety Objective Type Q A Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Safety MCQ
title: 安全常识十五问
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/17_Safety Objective Type Q A Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Safety MCQ.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/17_Safety Objective Type Q A Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Safety MCQ/src.py

points.K1: 安全管理：减少、控制、消除危害
points.S5: 高校事故损失不只医药费

shots.scene: 欣欣举着写有15的牌子，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank sign with a large number-shaped badge and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天十五道安全常识题，一起来答。

shots.scene: 一行图标：盾牌、钱袋、标志牌、心形
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a shield, a money bag, a safety sign and a heart. No people.
shots.narration: 管理、成本、标志、态度，一个不落。

shots.scene: 王老师带着阿杰和小研在实验楼走廊巡查
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads the young male student and the female graduate student on an inspection walk in a lab building corridor.
shots.narration: 王老师带新同学巡查实验楼。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着各色标志和报警灯
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at colorful signs and a warning beacon on the wall.
shots.narration: 边走边问，边看边答。

shots.section_title: 安全管理：减少、控制、消除危害
shots.scene: 危险图标依次变小、被框住、消失
shots.prompt_en: A hazard icon shrinks, then is boxed in, then disappears. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：安全管理管什么？
overlay: 安全管理：减少、控制、消除危害

shots.section_title: 安全管理：减少、控制、消除危害
shots.scene: 欣欣举起三个勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with three check marks.
shots.narration: 减少、控制、消除危害，三样都管。

shots.section_title: 安全管理：减少、控制、消除危害
shots.scene: 实验室例子：高毒试剂换低毒、通风柜、减少用量
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a toxic bottle swapped for a safer one, a fume hood and a smaller bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 比如换低毒试剂、用通风柜、减少用量。

shots.scene: 冰山图标，水下部分很大
shots.prompt_en: An iceberg icon with a small tip above water and a huge part below. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：哪些是事故的间接成本？

shots.scene: 水下部分出现时钟、停工的设备、调查报告图标
shots.prompt_en: Below the water appear icons of a clock, a stopped machine and an investigation report. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答损失的工时；停工、调查也算。

shots.scene: 冰山露出水面的部分：药箱和钱袋
shots.prompt_en: The tip of the iceberg shows a first aid kit and a money bag. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：直接成本呢？

shots.scene: 欣欣指着冰山顶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the tip of the iceberg.
shots.narration: 医疗费和赔偿金，看得见的那部分。

shots.scene: 检查表四格：工作区、材料、机器、工具
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with four boxes showing icons of a work area, materials, a machine and tools. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：危害分析检查表查什么？

shots.scene: 第五格加上人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A fifth box with a person icon is added to the checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答这四样，别忘了还有人。

shots.scene: 阿杰搬箱子时腰部红点
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends to lift a box; his lower back glows red.
shots.narration: 人的姿势和技能，也是危害来源。

shots.scene: 标志牌、彩色条纹、喇叭三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a sign board, colored stripes and a loudspeaker. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：安全信息用什么表达？

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 看得见的牌和颜色，听得见的声音，都是。

shots.scene: 火灾警铃和闪光灯
shots.prompt_en: A fire alarm bell ringing next to a flashing strobe light. No people.
shots.narration: 比如火警铃声，听到就要撤离。

shots.scene: 四类标志排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Four kinds of safety signs in a row: prohibition, warning, mandatory and emergency. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：安全标志有哪几种？

shots.scene: 一本书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 国内分禁止、警告、指令、提示四类。

shots.scene: 提示标志：洗眼器、紧急喷淋
shots.prompt_en: Green safe condition signs for an eyewash station and an emergency shower. No people.
shots.narration: 洗眼器、喷淋的位置，也用提示标志。

shots.scene: 红圈斜杠的禁止标志：禁止烟火
shots.prompt_en: A red circular no-smoking prohibition sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：禁止和危险用什么色？

shots.scene: 红色急停按钮和红色消防设备
shots.prompt_en: A red emergency stop button and red fire equipment. No people.
shots.narration: 红色：禁止、停止、消防设备。

shots.scene: 黄色三角警告标志：当心腐蚀
shots.prompt_en: A yellow triangular corrosive warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：警告用什么色？

shots.scene: 阿杰在黄色标志前放慢脚步
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slows down in front of a yellow warning sign.
shots.narration: 黄色：当心，这里有危险。

shots.scene: 蓝色圆形指令标志：必须戴护目镜
shots.prompt_en: A blue circular mandatory sign for eye protection. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：指令用什么色？

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles under the blue sign.
shots.narration: 蓝色：必须这样做。

shots.scene: 绿色紧急出口和急救标志
shots.prompt_en: Green emergency exit and first aid signs. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：疏散和急救用什么色？

shots.scene: 小研指着绿色箭头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points along a green exit arrow.
shots.narration: 绿色：告诉你出口和急救箱在哪。

shots.scene: 放射性实验室门上的黄色三角电离辐射警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A yellow triangular ionizing radiation warning sign on a laboratory door. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一题：辐射危害怎么标？

shots.scene: 原题紫色卡片旁打问号
shots.prompt_en: A purple color card with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答紫色，那是国外部分做法。

shots.scene: 一本书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 国内用当心电离辐射警告标志。

shots.scene: 三个图标：管理者、员工、工作环境
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a manager figure, a worker figure and a workplace building. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二题：事故谁有责任？

shots.scene: 三个图标连成三角
shots.prompt_en: The three icons connect into a triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 管理、个人、环境条件，三方都有。

shots.scene: 老周检查、阿杰遵守、老李修好设施三格图
shots.prompt_en: Three panels: the older man inspecting, the young male student following rules and the facility engineer repairing equipment.
shots.narration: 负责人管好制度，学生守规，设施完好。

shots.scene: 防护用品、安全员、警示牌三张卡片淡出
shots.prompt_en: Cards of protective gear, a safety officer badge and a warning sign fade out. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三题：什么能让你始终安全？

shots.scene: 阿杰头顶亮起一颗心和一只眼睛
shots.prompt_en: A heart and an eye icon glow above the young male student's head.
shots.narration: 自己的注意力和对安全的态度。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴着防护却分心看手机，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person wearing goggles but distracted by a phone at the bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 装备再全，一分心也会出事。

shots.scene: 走廊冒烟，小研往出口走
shots.prompt_en: Smoke drifts in a corridor and the female graduate student walks toward the exit.
shots.narration: 第十四题：火灾时首先关注什么？

shots.scene: 小研边走边按报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses a fire alarm call point on her way out.
shots.narration: 先保证自己安全，顺手报警提醒别人。

shots.scene: 电梯图标打红叉，楼梯图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An elevator icon crossed out and a stairway icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 走楼梯撤离，不乘电梯，不回头取物。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着镜子调整护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks his safety goggles in a mirror.
shots.narration: 第十五题：谁确保你戴对防护用品？

shots.scene: 王老师发放合格的防护用品
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands out new protective gloves and goggles.
shots.narration: 单位配发合格用品，戴好是自己的事。

shots.scene: 阿杰用前检查手套有无破损
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks his gloves for holes before use.
shots.narration: 用前检查，坏了及时换。

shots.scene: 黄黑条纹的地面警示线和红白条纹的隔离栏
shots.prompt_en: Yellow and black striped floor marking beside a red and white striped barrier. No people.
shots.narration: 条纹也是安全语言。

shots.scene: 黄黑条纹：当心磕碰、绊倒
shots.prompt_en: Yellow and black stripes on a low step and a pillar edge. No people.
shots.narration: 黄黑条纹：当心磕碰和绊倒。

shots.scene: 红白条纹：禁止越过
shots.prompt_en: A red and white striped barrier across a doorway. No people.
shots.narration: 红白条纹：禁止通行、不要越过。

shots.scene: 一本书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 安全色按国家标准，以现行文本为准。

shots.scene: 通风柜上的低风量报警灯闪烁
shots.prompt_en: A low airflow alarm light flashes on a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，声音和灯光也在报警。

shots.scene: 气体报警器亮红灯，鸣响
shots.prompt_en: A wall-mounted gas detector shows a red light with sound waves. No people.
shots.narration: 气体报警响了，停下操作、撤离报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手去关报警器，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand silencing an alarm without checking, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能嫌吵就关掉，先查原因。

shots.scene: 阿杰没戴护目镜，小研轻声提醒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student kindly reminds the young male student, who forgot his goggles.
shots.narration: 看到同学没做到，及时提醒。

shots.scene: 阿杰笑着戴上，比个谢谢
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on goggles and gives a thank-you gesture.
shots.narration: 被提醒时说谢谢，下次就记住了。

shots.scene: 阿杰的手套太大、护目镜压着眼镜，面露不适
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears oversized gloves and goggles pressing on his glasses, looking uncomfortable.
shots.narration: 防护用品不合身，就容易偷偷摘。

shots.scene: 换上合适尺码的手套和可罩眼镜的护目镜
shots.prompt_en: He switches to well-fitting gloves and over-the-glasses goggles.
shots.narration: 选对尺码，戴眼镜的用罩式护目镜。

shots.scene: 小研调整口罩鼻夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts the nose clip of her mask.
shots.narration: 调好松紧，舒服才能坚持戴。

shots.section_title: 高校事故损失不只医药费
shots.scene: 实验室门上贴着停用封条图标，仪器停摆
shots.prompt_en: A lab door with a blank closure notice and stopped instruments inside. No people.
shots.narration: 高校出了事故，损失远不止医药费。
overlay: 高校事故损失不只医药费

shots.section_title: 高校事故损失不只医药费
shots.scene: 日历翻页、样品失效、论文进度条后退
shots.prompt_en: A calendar flipping pages, spoiled sample tubes and a progress bar moving backward. No people.
shots.narration: 实验停摆、样品报废、学业延误。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在四色标志墙前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a wall of four-color safety signs.
shots.narration: 红禁止、黄警告、蓝指令、绿提示。

shots.scene: 冰山图标
shots.prompt_en: The iceberg icon again. No people.
shots.narration: 事故成本像冰山，看不见的更多。

shots.scene: 心形和护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon and a pair of goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 安全靠态度，防护自己戴好。

shots.scene: 报警灯和同伴握手图标
shots.prompt_en: A warning beacon icon and a handshake icon. No people.
shots.narration: 听懂报警，互相提醒。

shots.scene: 欣欣和三人在走廊挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the safety administrator and two students in the corridor.
shots.narration: 看懂标志，守住自己！
